biggest_catch: You receive no reward until the friend opens a new Ardent checking account AND completes at least 8 debit card purchases totaling $200+ within the first 60 days of account opening; rewards deposit within 60-90 days of account opening.
catches: Referrer must be an Ardent member age 18+ with accounts in good standing and an email address on file; Ardent employees and Board members are not eligible.
Friend must be a non-member age 18+, accept the referral via your personal link with the same email address used when joining.
Friend must open a new Ardent checking account and complete at least 8 debit card purchases totaling $200+ within the first 60 days of account opening.
Reward: $50 deposited into the referrer's chosen Ardent account within 60-90 days of the friend's account opening.
Cap: earn rewards for up to 10 successful referrals per calendar year = $500 max.

steps: Register for the Ardent Referral Program and generate your personal referral link (emailed to you).
Share your referral link with friends and family.
Friend accepts via your link with their email address and joins Ardent, opening a new checking account with the same email.
Friend completes at least 8 debit card purchases totaling $200+ within the first 60 days of account opening.
Receive $50 deposited into your chosen Ardent account within 60-90 days of their account opening.
timing: Rewards are deposited within 60-90 days of the friend's account opening; you get an email when each referral is successful.
